svg.title: ERCOT Large-Load Queue, Paper Megawatts to Forecast
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-ercot-paper-load-waterfall; chapter number: 3; chart type: waterfall; title: ERCOT Large-Load Queue, Paper Megawatts to Forecast; subtitle: Headline load requests haircut to what forecasters actually count; caption: The large-load queue is mostly paper; Dominion's zone shows 70 GW of requests against a 24 GW peak, and ERCOT Batch Zero demands $50,000/MW security to separate capitalized projects.; assumptions note: 438 GW, 218 GW and 148 GW are attributed practitioner figures. The 220 GW and 290 GW bars are simple arithmetic differences between those figures, not separately reported counts. The 218 GW and 148 GW figures are as of July 2025.; note: Adjusted forecast attributed to Data Centers Technical Info (S8vmSHwFrvE); Batch Zero security attributed to WhyPKD (EvpNriZrrME); workshop mechanics from James Dickey (9zpO8wwsfXc).; bars: label: ERCOT large-load requests through 2032; value: 438; display: 438 GW (438,000 MW); kind: total; label: Outside TSP letters, contracts or forecasts; value: 220; display: -220 GW (arithmetic bridge); kind: deduction; label: Submitted to forecasters; value: 218; display: 218 GW; kind: total; label: Haircut for historical energization delay; value: 70; display: -70 GW; kind: deduction; label: Adjusted large-load forecast, about 2032; value: 148; display: 148 GW; kind: result; label: Headline-to-forecast gap; value: 290; display: 290 GW of paper load (438 minus 148); kind: result
